label: director of organization
definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office of, for or at organization or institution Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit director/co-director; functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y; historical office. Excludes: head/president/chair/executive alone; spokesperson/adviser/publisher/professor/member alone; performing or authorship alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal with omitted organization; abstract topic in place of the actual institution. Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.

facts.reason: Mr. Bush → Mr. Arafat: Political mentions and demands or filing corporate certificates does not establish a person as director of the object institution.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
